subject: RP6 and RP12 Q13 share the same graph function
body: Test 2274 found: retake-practice-6 Q13 and retake-practice-12 Q13 both use function '4 / (x - 3) - 2'. Kai could memorize this pattern across exams. Recommend making RP12 Q13 unique. Q13 should always be a distinct rational function per exam.
